_readme: Wording and crisis resources for messages where a member signals risk to
their own life. Editable without a deploy — the service reads this file.
resources_verified is false and the list is empty ON PURPOSE. Nothing here
was taken from a model, and no number has been confirmed by anyone who owns
this desk. While it stays false the reply names no helpline at all: it
acknowledges the member, asks them to reach someone they trust, and says a
person will follow up. That is safe. A wrong helpline number is not.
TO ACTIVATE: confirm the current numbers with the institution (services in
Nepal include TPO Nepal and the national suicide prevention helpline —
verify both against a current official source, not this file), add them
below, then set resources_verified to true.
Each resource: name, contact, and optionally hours. Both languages are
shown the same list, so write the name in a form both audiences can read.
The message wording is a placeholder written by an engineer, not a
clinician or a native-speaker reviewer. Have both read it before this

ne.acknowledge: तपाईंले यो कुरा भन्नुभयो — यो सजिलो छैन, र तपाईं एक्लै हुनुहुन्न।
ne.reach_out: कृपया अहिले नै आफूले विश्वास गर्ने कोही — परिवार, साथी वा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस्।
ne.follow_up: हाम्रो टोलीका एक जना यहाँ तपाईंलाई सम्पर्क गर्नेछन्।

en.acknowledge: Thank you for telling me. That sounds very hard, and you are not alone.
en.reach_out: Please talk to someone you trust right now — family, a friend, or a health worker.
en.resources_intro: People you can talk to right now:
en.follow_up: Someone from our team will get in touch with you.
